title: Units of measure R1: refuse at build a raw total over a record-mode quantity unless it groups by the unit field
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Units of measure, release R1 (ADR-0158 U7). Parent: #35339. The ADR is the governing text: [ADR-0158](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md) (merged PR #35370, 35bd36082c). Filed on seat 5's word, 2026-11-19.

## What to build
R1 member "a build-time refusal of a raw aggregate over a `record`-mode quantity unless it groups by that quantity's unit field". It mirrors ADR-0144 D6 and its currency refusal.

## Open items this card carries
- OI12, aggregate half: which aggregates count as "raw" → #35469.

## Blocked
Blocked-by: #35489

Waits on the unitConfig and membership card, because the refusal reads `unitConfig`. It does not hang on OI8, since a quantity is always the subject here.

## Done when
A dataset or report that sums a record-mode quantity without grouping by its unit field is refused at build with a named code. The grouped form and a fixed-mode quantity pass. ADR-0158 is amended with the raw-aggregate set.

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:server.
